Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
I: Introduction

Welcome to the fourth installment of Stone Circle, the official Gargoyles
Newsletter. This month we will explore new strategies and cards that apply
to the most
untested yet most interesting of all the bloodlines, the Gargoyles.

II: Fiction

To: Etrius
From: Virstania
CC: Inner Circle of the Tremere
Subject: Re: Near invulnerability of constructs being disproportionate to
their age

During our study on construct 004.a, there have been several assaults on C5B
(a.k.a. the Chantry of the Five Boroughs in New York City) since the
reclamation of the domain of New York from Sabbat Forces and the subsequent
assassination attempt on the Prince. During these assaults, a new more
powerful gargoyle has emerged with strength and toughness that exceeds the
exceptional qualities that ordinary gargoyles possess. This gargoyle
construct is know as Ublo-Satha. It has shown exceptional durability, which
will be described in the forwarded report from Aisling Sturbridge.

WARNING: Possession of this data by non-members of the Tremere Inner Circle
or C5B research team: Luther will constitute a breach of Pyramid Security.
Immediate Counter-measures will be employed and suspension of all violator's
anima will be immediate and said violator(s) will remain in suspension until
a tribunal can be convened to mete out punishment (re: expunging of
pattern).

The below report was given by Aisling Sturbridge who both
witnessed the incident and hence-forth conducted the experiments which
provided the following results.

To: Virstania
From Aisling Sturbridge, overseer C5B research team: Luther
Subject: Near invulnerability of constructs being disproportionate to their
age

Shortly after construct 004.a (a.k.a. Fidus) was committed to suspension
chamber: Purgatory at C5B (a.k.a Chantry of the Five Boroughs), there were
several major Sabbat counter-offensives launched in New York City. None of
these offensives targeted the political structure, but rather, they targeted
C5B. Whether they were trying to secure some specific objective or whether
he offensive against C5B was an end unto itself, we will probably never
know, but we do suspect that the fiend Sascha Vykos was behind it. This
suspicion was supported by the mix of brute force troops armed with modern
weaponry mixed with a supporting group of Koldun sorcerers.

But I digress, this is not the reason for this missive reaching you. It was
during these assaults and subsequent repulsions that another of our
constructs distinguished itself. Construct 007.a (a.k.a Ublo-Satha, a.k.a.
childe of Harlequin, a.k.a. Stone Pillar, a.k.a. The Great Wall), while
standing at the apex of its battle formation, withstood an extremely
concentrated assault of Sabbat firepower. I truly say that in all of my
existence as both a mortal and a magus that I have never seen such a
conflagration fall upon a kindred. It was in fact so intense that several
supporting magus went into a state of Rotschrek.

Had construct 007.a been vaporized on the spot or merely dismembered, it
would have not been noteworthy. Not only did construct 007.a survive said
conflagration, but also walked away without an apparent scratch. Construct
007.a then pounced on one of the Sabbat vampires and tore his arms off,
leaving the vampire looking like a grotesque, performance-art version of the
Venus di Milo.

Construct 007.a then proceeded to employ the RPG launcher formerly wielded
by the aforementioned torso. Using the RPG launcher, construct 007.a then
proceeded to send to torpor the remaining Sabbat, both the brutes and the
supporting sorcerers.

The members of the Sabbat assault force have been staked and are waiting for
interrogation. We are waiting on your reply whether we should commence with
the interrogation ourselves or wait for the Fatherhouse to send a
representative to perform the task.

Sincerely,
Your Faithful Servant
Aisling Sturbridge

III: Card of the Month

Armor of Terra
Discipline(s): Visceratika
Thaumaturgy

Blood Cost: 1

+1 stealth action

thau- Put this card on a slave Gargoyle you control. The Gargoyle with this
card treats aggravated damage as normal damage. Burn this card if this
Gargoyle goes to torpor: A Gargoyle can have only one Armor of Terra

viss As above, but put this card on this acting Gargoyle

VIS- As above, and the Gargoyle with this card may prevent 1 damage each
combat

This card is the ultimate in damage modification. It converts all
aggravated damage to normal. This is great when going up against Gangrel,
Assimites, and White Phosphorus Grenade wielding OOT Malkavians. Not only
for converting aggravated damage that opposing vampires are attempting to
inflict upon you, but also that aggravated damage that you are attempting to
inflict upon yourself (i.e. via Burst of Sunlight or Dawn Op/Weather
Control)

As if that wasn't enough, if used at superior Visceratika, which 50% of all
Gargoyles have, then it acts as a flak jacket, and it only costs 1 blood!
This is the ultimate in non-transient small arms damage prevention.

IV: Vampire of the Month

Ublo-Satha

Clan: Gargoyles
Capacity: 7
Group: 2

Ability: Tremere Slave : Ublo-Satha may prevent 1 damage each combat. Brujah
get +1 bleed when bleeding Ublo-Satha's controller. Flight.

Disciplines :

Inferior Celerity
Superior Fortitude
Superior Potence
Superior Visceratika

This vampire is a hoss! All inclans at superior, as well as flight. Her
special is that she may prevent 1 damage per combat, when you combine this
with the armor of terra that is doubled to an impressive two damage per
combat rendering even inferior torn signposts ineffective on their first
strike.

There is a drawback though. Brujah get +1 bleed when bleeding you.
Generally, this bleed will not be at stealth, and therefore may be
alleviated merely adding wakes to the deck to provide blockers as you really
only need to fear the most intense combat or combat that bypass damage
prevention. Do remember that when it comes to combat Ublo-Satha gives as
good a she gets.

V: Deck of the Month

This months deck is Ben Peal's tournament winning O-Line deck that he won
the Bratislava tournament. Congratulations to Ben! His deck is the first
registered tournament winning Gargoyle deck. Now lets get to Ben's comments
on his deck and the Czech Republic and Slovakian Meta-Game.

The Deck:

Martin Dudik warned me in advance that Bratislava's metagame was
extreme combat. I had a Gargoyles deck in development that had
won 4 of 4 casual games, including one where I lent it to someone,
so I figured it was ready for prime time. It consists of weenie
Tremere 12, with Tremere Slaves operating like the offensive line
of an American football team, clearing the way for the Tremere.
As such, I've called it The O-Line. :) The Tremere are just
there for weenie bleeds, with the occasional Conditioning or J.S.
Simmons/Tasha Morgan, as well as Deflections. The Gargoyles are
Pot/For/Flight monsters, and they also handle the bulk of the defense,
with Razor Bats (which have proved surprisingly handy) and Defenders
of the Haven.

VI: Conclusion

I hope everyone enjoyed this months Stone circle and if anyone would like to
contribute then please email me at x_ze...@cox-internet.com . May the
Gargoyles soar into the skies above the conflagration of the Camarilla and
shine like the stars that they are. Until next newsletter....

VII: Gargoyle Haiku

destruction takes flight
horror weapon falling white
pigeon crap dive-bomber

--
Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr.
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp
